facts.claim: An application for allotment of properties in GIDC estates is accepted online.
facts.subject: application_for_allotment
facts.evidence: Application for allotment of properties in GIDC estates is accepted online.

facts.claim: Applicants must submit online copies of the application and required documents, including a project presentation, for the application to be considered complete.
facts.subject: application_for_allotment
facts.evidence: An application will be considered complete after the applicant submits the online copies of application and required documents (including project presentation).

facts.claim: Applicants must submit a printed copy of the system-generated application and acknowledgment receipt along with all necessary documents via Registered post (RPAD) to the office of the concerned Regional Manager within 30 days from the date of applying online.
facts.subject: application_for_allotment
facts.evidence: The applicant has to submit the print out of the system generated application and acknowledgement receipt along with all necessary documents through Registered post (RPAD) to the office of concerned Regional Manager within 30 days from the date of applying online.

facts.claim: If the required documents are not received within the prescribed time limit, the application will be cancelled.
facts.subject: application_for_allotment
facts.evidence: If above mentioned documents are not received within prescribed time limit then application stands cancelled.

facts.claim: Applicants are not allowed to vary from the details submitted online. No changes are allowed once the details are submitted.
facts.subject: application_for_allotment
facts.evidence: The applicants shall not be allowed to vary from the details submitted by him/her online. No change shall be allowed in the details once it is submitted online.

facts.claim: Applicants must register on the portal to make an online application.
facts.subject: application_for_allotment
facts.evidence: You will need to first register on the portal to make an Online Application.

facts.claim: Applicants must agree to the terms and conditions by clicking on the checkbox before the online application link is activated.
facts.subject: application_for_allotment
facts.evidence: You will have to agree to these terms and conditions by clicking on the check box which you will find at the bottom of the page which opens with the given link. Only after you have clicked on the check box, the link for online application will activate.

facts.claim: Applicants can search for a property/properties after clicking on the online application link.
facts.subject: application_for_allotment
facts.evidence: After clicking on Online Application link you can Search for a property/properties.

facts.claim: GIDC field offices will evaluate the application and may request additional documents, information, or clarification from the applicant.
facts.subject: application_for_allotment
facts.evidence: GIDC field office will thoroughly evaluate/scrutinize the application along with the documents submitted and If require GIDC may ask for additional documents/ information/clarification from the applicant.

facts.claim: If all submitted documents meet the requirements, the field office will confirm the application and assign a priority number to the applicant.
facts.subject: application_for_allotment
facts.evidence: After scrutiny if all submitted documents meeting the requirements , field office will confirm the application and a priority number will be assigned to applicant

facts.claim: After confirmation, the application will be forwarded to the head office for evaluation of the submitted project report and presentation.
facts.subject: application_for_allotment
facts.evidence: After confirmation of the application, it will be forwarded to head office to check/evaluate the submitted project report and presentation to determine the possibility of allotment to the applicant.

facts.claim: If any requirements in the application are unclear, GIDC may contact the applicant for clarification or request a presentation of the proposed project/unit at the GIDC head office for counseling.
facts.subject: application_for_allotment
facts.evidence: If any of the requirement mentioned in the application isn’t clear than GIDC will either contact applicant for clarification or if require GIDC will ask applicant for further information verification/ presentation of their proposed project/unit at GIDC head office for counselling before the final decision of land allotment.

facts.claim: During counseling, GIDC may suggest changes to the applicant to meet the required norms and criteria defined by the corporation.
facts.subject: application_for_allotment
facts.evidence: During counselling of applicant corporation will suggest the applicant to match the required norms and criteria defined by corporation like water demand, power demand, effluent generation, solid waste generation and any other requirement needs to be corrected.

facts.claim: If everything is found to be in order, GIDC will issue an online allotment letter to the applicant.
facts.subject: application_for_allotment
facts.evidence: If everything found to be in order by GIDC, system generated an online allotment letter will be awarded to the applicant.

facts.claim: The procedural steps for application are uniform and applicable across all types of establishments, regardless of risk category, firm size, business location, or type of investor.
facts.subject: application_for_allotment
facts.evidence: The procedural steps outlined above are uniform, consistent, and applicable across all types of establishments, regardless of their risk category, firm size/category (small, medium, large), business location (whether rural or urban), and the type of investor (whether foreign or domestic).
